findings.title: UNICEF reports recent rejection of equipment for $3 million Sheikh Radwan stormwater basin repair plan
findings.location: Sheikh Radwan stormwater basin, Gaza City, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: Displaced Gaza City residents in flood-risk camps and streets; sewage-contaminated stormwater basin, sanitation, water, disease exposure, flood prevention; repair equipment/import approval and $3 million rehabilitation proposal.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: but that COGAT, the Israeli military agency overseeing humanitarian affairs in Gaza, had rejected the project in the past few days.
findings.source_type: Established independent international news agency quoting a named UNICEF spokesperson at a briefing; reporting no immediate COGAT comment

bounded_discovery_context.new_evidence: The specific reported rejection in recent days and the $3 million repair plan were not logged in the immediately preceding heartbeat.
bounded_discovery_context.verification: Reuters quotes UNICEF's James Elder and specifies COGAT rejection; UNICEF's dated November 9 statement independently describes prolonged repair equipment access problems and a partially functioning basin.
bounded_discovery_context.uncertainty: Exact date of rejection, formal written decision and Israeli authorities' response not independently verified; no new flooding or injuries attributed to this rejection.
bounded_discovery_context.search_source: Targeted press-agency search #1 returned Reuters; direct Reuters and UNICEF reads.

findings.title: WAFA reports three killed in an al-Daraj house airstrike, compared with one previously reported near a school
findings.location: House of the Ghabayen family near Musa bin Nuseir School, al-Daraj neighborhood, eastern Gaza City, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: Three fatalities according to WAFA, identities and civilian status unverified. An earlier Reuters item reported one person killed near a Daraj school. Whether the reports represent the same event and whether the net number of victims changed remain unresolved.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Three Palestinians were killed today in an Israeli airstrike targeting Gaza City.
findings.source_type: Palestinian news agency report attributed to its correspondent; no independent casualty confirmation of revised number

bounded_discovery_context.comparison: Prior verified heartbeat records one Daraj near-school fatality via Reuters. New WAFA report describes Ghabayen house near Musa bin Nuseir School and three deaths. AP and Reuters still describe a total of four fatalities across two Gaza City strikes and Khan Younis.
bounded_discovery_context.no_double_count: Do not add two to any death tally absent confirmation; contradictory casualty figures, geographic overlap and timing remain unresolved.
bounded_discovery_context.uncertainty: Specific time of strike not documented; WAFA's three-person toll conflicts with Reuters/AP descriptions, so this is an uncorroborated revision, not proof of additional deaths.
bounded_discovery_context.search_source: Direct WAFA homepage check and article read following the bounded 12 searches.
